name: Check Sky Light
description: Check Sky Light is a field-grade civilian sky diagnostics and UAP forensic platform. Point your camera at any aerial anomaly to cross-reference live ADS-B transponders, NORAD satellite passes, and celestial ephemeris. Features a 3-tier Gemini AI diagnostic engine for optical video/photo analysis, 2-party smartphone 3D triangulation, synthetic media/CGI detection, and certified PDF/MUFON incident dossiers.
